title: About Us
html:
About Us

The OllieTree Foundation is a dedicated non-profit organization 501(c)(3) founded and registered in Charlotte, North Carolina, in 2018. Our mission is to enhance the well-being of our community through education, health advocacy, and compassionate care.

Our Focus Areas:

  • Promoting Health and Wellness: We strive to make medical and health knowledge accessible to all, empowering individuals to lead healthier lives through information and resources.
  • Advocating Healthy Lifestyles: By promoting wellness practices and healthy living, we aim to prevent disease and improve overall quality of life.
  • Supporting Educational Ministries: We believe that education is a powerful tool for change. Our programs are designed to educate and inspire individuals across various age groups and backgrounds.
  • Providing Community Medical Consultation: Our outreach includes offering medical consultations to those in need, ensuring that everyone has access to essential health services.
  • Caring for the Elderly: We are committed to improving the quality of life for our senior community members through dedicated care and support.

At The OllieTree Foundation, our goal is to assist the underserved and vulnerable populations in our community by leveraging medical expertise and educational resources. We are driven by a passion for making a positive impact and fostering a healthier, more informed society.

Join us in our mission to create lasting change and build a stronger, healthier community for all.
